mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index predicts higher expected future discount rates, which reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby lowering S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Over a 60-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a constant mean (Granger causality F-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS labor compensation growth signals stronger wage growth expectations, which raises corporate profit expectations and boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In regimes with falling PAYEMS, the 60-day forward return is not significantly higher than the 20-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in GDPC1 personal consumption (≥2 quarters) indicates weakening near-term demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly decline for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 100 such triggered events, less than 10% produce positive 5-day forward returns (binomial test).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly expansion in INDPRO industrial production accompanied by a simultaneous decline in RSAFS retail sales suggests supply-chain imbalances, which can depress equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO up while RSAFS down in the same month
failure_condition: In 100 such events, the 20-day forward return is not statistically negative (one-tailed t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4%, the tightened policy increases the real discount rate, reducing expected future equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: During FEDFUNDS > 4% regimes, 20-day forward returns are not systematically negative (Granger causality p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE unemployment (≥0.2 percentage points in one month) predicts a pessimistic labor market outlook, lowering S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by ≥0.2 percentage points in a month
failure_condition: In 50 such events, the 60-day forward return is not statistically lower than the mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in HOUST housing starts exceeding 2% year-over-year for two months indicate renewed building momentum, which can signal economic resilience and support positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly YoY growth ≥2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 30 such triggers, the 5-day forward return is not significantly positive (binomial test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO and GDPC1 both show simultaneous monthly growth exceeding 2%, it suggests robust supply-side expansion that can lift equity valuations and produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO up ≥2% and GDPC1 up ≥2% in the same month
failure_condition: In 100 such events, the 60-day forward return is not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
